people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Laban
people.line: Brother of Rebekah; father of Leah and Rachel

translations.web: Jacob said to Laban, “Give me my wife, for my days are fulfilled, that I may go in to her.”
translations.bsb: Finally Jacob said to Laban, “Grant me my wife, for my time is complete, and I want to sleep with her.”
